compaction_policy: Priority-based: system messages never dropped, oldest non-system turns dropped first, emergency truncation of incoming turn

test_cases.description: Hard constraint in oldest turn should survive compaction
test_cases.method: Create conversation with hard constraint in turn 1, exceed token budget, verify constraint retained
test_cases.expected: Hard constraint appears in reconstructed context (system message priority)
test_cases.actual: PASS - hard constraints stored as structured field, always included in reconstruction as system message

test_cases.description: Decision in oldest turn should survive compaction if budget allows
test_cases.method: Create conversation with decision in turn 1, exceed token budget, verify decision retained if budget allows
test_cases.expected: Decision retained in reconstructed context (decisions field, last 10 included)
test_cases.actual: PASS - decisions stored as structured field, last 10 included in reconstruction as system message

test_cases.description: Incoming turn should always be included even under extreme budget pressure
test_cases.method: Set token_budget=30, create 20 long turns, verify incoming turn included
test_cases.expected: Incoming turn always included, oldest turns dropped first
test_cases.actual: PASS - incoming turn always included, emergency truncation applied to incoming if absolutely necessary

conclusion: Compaction safety verified. Hard constraints, decisions, and incoming turns are protected by priority-based reconstruction. System messages never dropped. Only oldest non-system conversation turns are dropped when budget exceeded.
